experiments.name: MIL-STD-810H Method 502.7 Procedure II low-temperature operation test at the Cold (C2) design extreme, -46 C, with at least 2 h soak after stabilization

notes: Tavily (plan limit), WebSearch (turn budget) and Lune (daily quota) were exhausted during this run, so sources were read with WebFetch plus local pdftotext of the fetched PDFs, and one Consensus search. Quotes from layout-extracted PDFs have collapsed whitespace; the PDF degree glyphs were restored as the degree sign. MIL-STD-810H does not fix single temperatures: the -46 C (C2) and -51 C (C3) operating points are the tailored values from Table 502.7-I, and Method 503.7 directs users to those tables for cold-region ground transfer. The ANSI N42.34 size requirements use the ORTEC Detective-X envelope as the device under test (circumscribed footprint diameter 426.2 mm rounded up to 427 mm). The Ricor K508 profile uses the manufacturer's rating points as the acceptance test. The Hingst JT spray-cooler source is the published abstract (Consensus record); the DOI could not be confirmed with the tools available. The Twente degaussing quotes are from the abstract on the University of Twente publication page (the full PDF returned 403). The HPGe 77 K requirement is sourced to the Japanese NRA germanium-spectrometry method because the HPA report gives no crystal temperature.
